plays.desc_ko: DCG가 정글러 Pop9의 합류와 함께 바텀에서 교전을 걸어 Yan의 점멸을 뽑아냄. ShiauC도 점멸을 써서 점멸 교환이 되었고, CoreJJ의 우주의 결속이 맞고 Feng이 약간의 견제를 받았지만 해설은 DCG가 원하던 것을 얻었다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: DCG starts a bot lane fight with Pop9 (Jarvan IV) joining, forcing Yan's (Varus) Flash. ShiauC (Rakan) also burns Flash for an even trade, and while CoreJJ (Bard) lands Cosmic Binding and Feng (Jhin) takes some poke, the casters say DCG got what it wanted.
plays.quote: Quick flash back from Yan. ... that is flash for flash traded ... good deal for the side of DCG

plays.desc_ko: DCG 전원이 바텀 강가/칼날부리 쪽에 모인 상황에서 TLAW 쪽 한 명(문맥상 Morgan으로 추정)이 과감하게 텔레포트로 합류해 바위게·칼날부리 경합을 시도. 텔 직후 큰 피해를 입었고 해설은 이상적이지 않다고 평가. 이후 이 경합이 퍼스트 블러드 교전으로 이어짐.
plays.desc_en: With all of DCG grouped near the bot river and raptors, a TLAW player (likely Morgan's Ornn) boldly Teleports in to contest Scuttle and raptors, but takes heavy damage right away in what the casters call a less-than-ideal move. The contest leads into the First Blood fight.
plays.quote: a very aggressive TP in. ... Definitely not ideal. ... contest these raptors with all of DCG

plays.desc_ko: DCG가 바텀 쪽 TL 정글 입구에서 숫자 우위로 덮쳐 추격전을 벌임. Rakan 점멸 연계, Cassiopeia의 독 폭발 이동속도로 끝까지 따라붙었고 독 피해로 마무리, Feng이 퍼스트 블러드를 가져감. Flauren이 Morgan의 점멸도 뽑음. 해설은 Feng이 리콜을 취소해 수적 우위가 생겼다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: DCG collapses with a numbers advantage at TL's bot-side jungle entrance and gives chase, with Rakan's Flash combo and Cassiopeia's Noxious Blast move speed keeping them on the target until poison finishes it and Feng (Jhin) claims First Blood. Flauren (Rumble) also forces Morgan's (Ornn) Flash, and the casters note Feng cancelling his recall created the numbers edge.
plays.quote: IT'S FIRST BLOOD FOR DCG. ... BARELY ABLE TO WALK AWAY. ... Floren Morgan forcing that flash there.

plays.desc_ko: DCG가 바텀에서 추가 공세를 걸어 Pop9의 대격변(즉시 궁)으로 Yan을 가두고 Feng이 킬을 가져감. Yan은 앞서 점멸을 이미 쓴 상태였고 귀환/도주 시도가 통하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: DCG pushes another bot lane attack as Pop9 (Jarvan IV) traps Yan (Varus) with a quick Cataclysm and Feng (Jhin) takes the kill. Yan had already used Flash, and his attempts to recall or escape fail.
plays.quote: instantaneous cataclysm back from Yan ... does not work out for him ... Fungus just been able to grab the kill

plays.desc_ko: ShiauC(Rakan)가 미드로 로밍해 Akali(Quid)를 노리고 이니시에이팅했지만 Akali가 있을 수 없는 위치로 진입해 빗나감. Akali는 독 장판(미아즈마) 쪽에서 피해만 약간 입음. 해설은 무리한 이니시라고 평가.
plays.desc_en: ShiauC (Rakan) roams mid and engages on Quid (Akali), but misses as Akali moves somewhere he can't reach, taking only a bit of damage from Miasma. The casters call it a forced engage.
plays.quote: that was just not a good recon. ... outline. There's just no way she was ... but good still to see the roam into the

plays.desc_ko: Josedeodo가 상단에서 공허 유충을 시작하고 CoreJJ가 Shia보다 먼저 로밍 합류, Morgan은 탑에서 강한 딜교환으로 Flauren을 밀어내고 빠르게 합류. 유충 결과는 '2대1'로 언급되나 어느 팀이 2마리인지 불명확.
plays.desc_en: Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) starts Void Grubs topside, CoreJJ (Bard) roams in ahead of ShiauC, and Morgan (Ornn) pushes Flauren (Rumble) back with a strong trade before quickly joining. The grubs end up split 2-1, though it's unclear which team took two.
plays.quote: Yeah, you can already see though Jos ... Deoto has started this up ... course slightly ahead of Shia on the

plays.desc_ko: DCG가 유충 경합에 들어가 Pop9의 강타가 실패, Quid에게 CC를 넣으려 했으나 Akali가 장막으로 생존. CoreJJ의 결속과 궁, Morgan의 호른까지 터지며 상단 난전으로 번짐. Flauren의 이퀄라이저 속에 Josedeodo가 초승달 수호자로 버티다 결국 사망, 양 팀 정글러 모두 쓰러짐.
plays.desc_en: DCG contests the grubs but Pop9's (Jarvan IV) Smite fails, and his attempt to CC Quid is survived by Akali's Twilight Shroud. CoreJJ's Cosmic Binding and ultimate plus Morgan's Brittle horn turn it into a topside brawl, where Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) holds out with Crescent Guard in Flauren's (Rumble) The Equalizer before dying, and both junglers fall.
plays.quote: Smite from Pop 9 does not work out. ... he's stealth. He's fine. ... QUIT RUNNING FOR HIS

plays.desc_ko: 상단 교전 직후 미드에서 포탑 방패(플레이트)를 챙김; Quid가 라인으로 복귀해 막으려 했지만 버티지 못함.
plays.desc_en: Right after the topside fight, DCG takes a mid turret plate; Quid (Akali) returns to lane to stop it but can't hold.
plays.quote: is able to at least to grab the ... Quid forced to come back to lane ... can't comfortably stay anymore.

plays.desc_ko: Pop9가 TL 칼날부리 캠프를 노리고 침투. CoreJJ가 이를 발견해 큰 칼날부리 하나를 챙겼지만 Pop9가 나머지 캠프를 가져갔고 Josedeodo는 칼날부리를 잃음.
plays.desc_en: Pop9 (Jarvan IV) invades TL's raptor camp. CoreJJ (Bard) spots him and grabs the big raptor, but Pop9 takes the rest and Josedeodo loses the camp.
plays.quote: couple of those early plays as CJ spots ... he takes the Raptor. ... Of course, Pop 9 still gets

plays.desc_ko: Josedeodo가 미드 라인 근처를 서성이며 경험치를 흡수해 6레벨을 달성. 발각되지 않은 것으로 보임.
plays.desc_en: Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) lingers near mid lane soaking experience to hit level 6, apparently unnoticed.
plays.quote: Is he trying to siphon ... Level six is there. ... spotted.

plays.desc_ko: HongSuo의 독 장판이 깔리고 ShiauC가 미드에서 각을 봤지만 실행하지 않고 바텀 Feng 지원으로 돌아감. 해설은 용 전에 점멸을 빼려는 탐색이었으나 실패했다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: HongSuo (Cassiopeia) drops Miasma and ShiauC (Rakan) looks for an angle mid, but holds off and heads back to support Feng bot. The casters say it was a failed probe to burn Flash before dragon.
plays.quote: The Myasma comes down. ... angle to make a play here, but I think ... we'll just walk back to the bottom lane.

plays.desc_ko: 상단에서 Cassiopeia(HongSuo)의 로밍 딜로 Morgan이 위기, Pop9와 Josedeodo의 정글 1:1에서 Josedeodo가 초승달 수호자로 밀어내고 버팀. 이어 Pop9가 점멸 평타로 도주하던 Quid를 노리는 무리한 시도를 하며 상단은 1대1 교환으로 끝남. 리플레이에서 해설은 Josedeodo가 이를 읽고 하나를 되갚았고 Pop9는 굳이 그렇게 공격적일 필요가 없었다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: HongSuo's (Cassiopeia) roaming damage puts Morgan (Ornn) in danger, while Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) holds off Pop9 (Jarvan IV) in a jungle duel with Crescent Guard. Pop9 then overreaches with a Flash auto on the fleeing Quid, and the skirmish ends one-for-one; on replay the casters say Josedeodo read it and struck back while Pop9 didn't need to be so aggressive.
plays.quote: oh my gosh that is a lot of damage from ... guard to knock back Pop 9 is big. ... one on the top side on the way in.

plays.desc_ko: 상단 교전과 동시에 바텀에서 CoreJJ가 미니언을 관통하는 우주의 결속으로 CC를 걸고 마법의 여정으로 합류, Yan이 Feng을 처치. Feng의 방어막으로는 부족.
plays.desc_en: During the topside fight, CoreJJ (Bard) lands Cosmic Binding through a minion and joins via Magical Journey as Yan (Varus) takes down Feng (Jhin), whose shield isn't enough.
plays.quote: LANE AS FONGU'S IN TROUBLE. THE BARRIER ... picking up the kill. Great binding from ... Core JJ onto the minions actually set up

plays.desc_ko: 바텀 킬 이후 CoreJJ가 ShiauC를 포탑에서 떼어놓으며 TL이 바텀 포탑 방패를 추가로 챙김.
plays.desc_en: After the bot kill, CoreJJ (Bard) zones ShiauC (Rakan) off the turret as TL takes more bot turret plates.
plays.quote: continuing to keep Shia off this ... bot turret so they can get a few more

plays.desc_ko: 용 둥지 교전에서 CoreJJ 궁이 떨어지고 50:50 강타 싸움에서 Josedeodo가 이겨 용을 확보. Pop9의 강타 타이밍이 늦었고, 호른이 2명을 맞혔지만 후방에 띄운 인원은 없었으며 DCG 전원이 후퇴. 이후 '용 1:1'로 정리.
plays.desc_en: In the dragon pit fight CoreJJ's ultimate lands and Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) wins a 50-50 Smite battle as Pop9 (Jarvan IV) Smites late. Morgan's (Ornn) horn hits two but nobody in the backline, and DCG retreats, leaving dragons at 1-1.
plays.quote: ALULTI COMING DOWN. JOS ... The 50 steel ... JOSE DODO. POP NINE a little bit off on

plays.desc_ko: 용 확보 후 TL이 도주하는 Flauren을 추격. Flauren의 전기 작살은 Josedeodo에게 맞지 않았고 Quid가 표창-도약으로 마무리.
plays.desc_en: After the dragon TL chases the fleeing Flauren (Rumble), whose Electro Harpoon misses Josedeodo, and Quid (Akali) finishes him with Five Point Strike and Shuriken Flip.
plays.quote: Maybe they want a bit more as Floren ... tries to escape. ... connect on Josto.

plays.desc_ko: 미드에서 DCG가 Yan을 덮침. 즉시 속박당했고 CoreJJ가 몇 초를 벌었지만 매혹이 끝나며 Yan의 마법의 여정 탈출도 실패, 주변에 다른 TL 인원이 없어 지켜내지 못함. 점멸이 없는 Yan을 DCG가 집요하게 노렸다는 평가.
plays.desc_en: DCG jumps Yan (Varus) mid and roots him instantly. CoreJJ (Bard) buys a few seconds, but the charm ends, Yan's escape through Magical Journey fails, and with no other TL nearby he can't be saved. DCG relentlessly targeted the flashless Yan.
plays.quote: Jan is going to be in trouble ... immediately rooted core buys a couple of ... just too much damage on the side of DCG

plays.desc_ko: 전령이 생성되자 Flauren이 올라갈지 고민했으나 DCG는 일단 내주는 쪽을 택하고 TL이 전령을 진행. 해설은 TL이 DCG가 경합할 수 없는 위치임을 알았다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: As Herald spawns, Flauren (Rumble) considers heading up but DCG concedes and TL takes it. The casters say TL knew DCG couldn't contest from where they were.
plays.quote: Rift Herald up and available ... Herald. But looks like DCG just going to ... nine going in. They will give it,

plays.desc_ko: DCG가 전령 이후 싸움을 노리고 Pop9가 진입, Flauren의 이퀄라이저가 상단을 가로지름. 그러나 Pop9가 Morgan의 궁에 홀로 맞아 교전 시작 전에 녹았고, 홀로 측면에 있던 Flauren도 점멸로 탑/미드 포탑 사이를 빠져나가려다 묶여 처치됨. 해설은 DCG가 과하게 들어갔다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: DCG looks to fight after Herald, with Pop9 (Jarvan IV) diving in and Flauren's (Rumble) The Equalizer across topside. But Pop9 alone eats Morgan's ultimate and melts before the fight starts, and Flauren, isolated on the flank, is caught trying to Flash out between the top and mid turrets. The casters say DCG overcommitted.
plays.quote: but they might be looking for a fight ... Nice equalizer across the ... nine. He'll get deleted before the fight

plays.desc_ko: Morgan이 뒤쪽에서 텔레포트로 DCG 한가운데로 들어가 궁으로 Pop9를 띄우며(이중 넉업) 교전을 뒤집음. Quid는 즉시 후열로 파고들고, Yan은 측면의 Flauren을 포착, Josedeodo가 추격해 Flauren을 놓치지 않음. 리플레이에서 Shia의 넉업 이후 Pop9가 마무리되며 DCG 메인 이니시가 사라졌다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: Morgan (Ornn) Teleports in behind DCG and launches Pop9 with his ultimate in a double knockup to flip the fight. Quid (Akali) dives the backline, Yan (Varus) catches Flauren on the flank, and Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) chases him down; on replay, Pop9 falls after the knockup, removing DCG's main engage.
plays.quote: there's a TP TP from behind. ... Alti coming in from Morgan is ... between towers. Can't quite do it. gets

plays.desc_ko: 전령 교전 승리 후 TL이 미드 포탑을 파괴.
plays.desc_en: After winning the Herald fight, TL destroys the mid turret.
plays.quote: can see mid lane tower down.

plays.desc_ko: Morgan이 바텀 라인을 밀어 넣으며 바텀 포탑까지 가져가려 함; 해설은 가져갈 수 있을 것으로 봄.
plays.desc_en: Morgan (Ornn) shoves the bot wave in to go for the bot turret, which the casters expect TL can take.
plays.quote: Morgan has ... to push in bot. He's going to be able to ... he? Yeah, should be able to take it just

plays.desc_ko: 세 번째 용 앞 교전을 Morgan이 시작. 호른 넉업은 아무도 맞지 않았고 궁도 빗나갔지만 CoreJJ의 결속으로 4명이 묶임. Yan의 벽 너머 Q는 빗나가고 Quid는 후방 진입 후 밀려남. Morgan이 계속 전진하며 DCG를 밀어냄. 피해는 크지 않았고 모두 살아서 빠짐.
plays.desc_en: Morgan (Ornn) opens the fight before the third dragon; his horn and ultimate miss, but CoreJJ's (Bard) Cosmic Binding ties up four. Yan's (Varus) over-the-wall Piercing Arrow misses and Quid (Akali) is pushed back after diving, but Morgan keeps advancing to drive DCG off, with little damage and everyone surviving.
plays.quote: But Morgan going to ... be the one to kick it off. ... Four members locked up.

plays.desc_ko: 교전으로 DCG를 밀어낸 뒤 TL이 세 번째 용을 획득.
plays.desc_en: Having pushed DCG back, TL takes the third dragon.
plays.quote: but it's TL in control of the Drake. ... Drake picked up.

plays.desc_ko: 용 이후 TL이 빠른 공격을 유도하려는 매복(함정)을 깔았지만 DCG의 예견의 꽃(스크라이어 블룸)에 발각됨. 이후 DCG도 시야가 부족해 더 들어오지 않음.
plays.desc_en: After dragon TL sets an ambush to bait a quick attack, but DCG spots it with a Scryer's Bloom, and lacking vision themselves, DCG doesn't push further in.
plays.quote: TL maybe laying a ... trap here trying to force a fast play ... but gets spotted by the scriers bloom.

plays.desc_ko: Cassiopeia(HongSuo)가 탑에서 Morgan을 상대로 천천히 포탑을 깎음. 해설은 Morgan이 버티기 좋은 상대라 즉시 포탑을 가져가기는 어렵다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: HongSuo (Cassiopeia) slowly chips the top turret against Morgan (Ornn), though the casters say Morgan holds well enough that it won't fall right away.
plays.quote: Casio here in the top lane slowly ... working away at the tower.

plays.desc_ko: TL이 상단 DCG 정글로 매우 공격적으로 침투, 강타 싸움에서 Josedeodo가 이겨 레드 버프를 확보.
plays.desc_en: TL invades DCG's topside jungle very aggressively, and Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) wins the Smite fight to take the red buff.
plays.quote: so well very aggressive in ... vade here on the top side from team ... secure the red buff so has to be a bit

plays.desc_ko: HongSuo가 예견의 꽃과 와드로 Josedeodo를 확인했지만 Josedeodo가 이미 접근해 1:1로 압도. CoreJJ가 넉백·추가 속박으로 거들었고 ShiauC는 제때 오지 못함. 처치 크레딧은 CoreJJ, 해설은 정글러의 미드 솔로킬에 가깝다고 강조.
plays.desc_en: HongSuo (Cassiopeia) spots Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) with a Scryer's Bloom and ward, but he's already close and overwhelms her one-on-one, with CoreJJ (Bard) adding a knockback and extra root while ShiauC arrives too late. CoreJJ gets the kill, but the casters stress it was practically a jungler solo kill.
plays.quote: just going in for the 1 v one and is ... JUST WALK IN AND SOLO KILL A MID LANER. ... end going to take away the kill credit,

plays.desc_ko: 미드 픽 이후 TL이 Akali를 텔레포트로 합류시켜 탑 포탑을 파괴; 더 노렸을 수도 있으나 탑 포탑과 미드 푸시로 만족.
plays.desc_en: After the mid pick, Quid (Akali) Teleports in as TL destroys the top turret, settling for that and a mid push rather than pushing for more.
plays.quote: Liquid going to be able to take this top ... They TPD in with Akali as ... the top tower take and this push now in

plays.desc_ko: TL이 탑 쪽에서 DCG 선수 한 명을 노려 Morgan이 호른을 터뜨리고 벽 박치기 넉업을 노렸지만, 대상이 폭발 열매와 텔레포트, 대시로 아슬아슬하게 탈출. 리플레이에서 벽에 조금만 가까웠으면 넉업이 됐을 것이라는 평가. DCG는 킬을 내주지 않았지만 텔레포트를 소모.
plays.desc_en: TL hunts a DCG player topside as Morgan (Ornn) uses his horn and goes for a Searing Charge wall knockup, but the target narrowly escapes with a Blast Cone, Teleport and a dash. The replay shows it would have hit with slightly closer wall positioning; DCG avoids the kill but burns Teleport.
plays.quote: once again blown. ... Has the blast cone. TP is there. DASH ... What an escape.

plays.desc_ko: 추격 실패 후 Quid가 탑 라인에서 견제 없이 포탑 방패를 챙김.
plays.desc_en: After the failed chase, Quid (Akali) takes a top turret plate unchallenged.
plays.quote: but Quid uncontested for ... now in the top lane able to grab a plate

plays.desc_ko: Morgan의 궁으로 교전 개시, ShiauC가 즉시 맞받아쳤으나 Yan의 궁이 후열을 묶으며 TL 우세로 기욺. Flauren은 Josedeodo를 녹이려다 실패하고 도주, CoreJJ의 마법의 여정과 Yan의 화살로 Flauren 처치. 리플레이에서 CoreJJ가 HongSuo를 노리고 Quid가 장막으로 후열에 들어가 킬을 만들며 DCG를 갈라냈다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: Morgan's (Ornn) ultimate opens the fight and ShiauC (Rakan) answers instantly, but Yan's (Varus) ultimate locks the backline and tilts it toward TL. Flauren (Rumble) fails to melt Josedeodo and flees, dying to CoreJJ's (Bard) Magical Journey and Yan's arrows; the replay shows CoreJJ targeting HongSuo while Quid (Akali) slips into the backline with Twilight Shroud to split DCG apart.
plays.quote: in from Morgan. Look for the multi ... the backline means that this fight is ... SO MAGICAL FOR FLOREN. ARROW through the

plays.desc_ko: Flauren이 쓰러지는 사이 Pop9가 Morgan에게 재진입, Quid가 점멸로 물러나고 DCG가 다시 싸움을 걺. Morgan이 속박되고 Bellows breath로 넉업을 끊었지만 결국 쓰러짐. ShiauC는 계속 전진해 공간을 만들었고, 해설은 Josedeodo가 용을 치느라 없었기에 DCG가 하나를 되갚을 수 있었다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: As Flauren falls, Pop9 (Jarvan IV) re-engages on Morgan (Ornn), Quid Flashes back, and DCG restarts the fight. Morgan is rooted and breaks a knockup with Bellows Breath but eventually dies, while ShiauC (Rakan) keeps pushing forward; the casters say Josedeodo's absence on dragon let DCG get one back.
plays.quote: 9 opts for a re-engage onto Morgan. ... Quinn forced to flash back. ... once more. Root onto Morgan. Knock up

plays.desc_ko: 교전이 이어지는 동안 Josedeodo는 싸움에 참여하지 않고 용을 공략.
plays.desc_en: While the fight continues, Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) skips it to take the dragon.
plays.quote: feel like they have in the tank? As Jos ... focusing down the drake.

plays.desc_ko: DCG가 미드에서 다이브를 시도하며 속박을 걸었지만 후속 진입이 붙지 않음. 해설은 DCG가 확실히 커밋하지 않은 망설임이 Yan의 궁 기회를 줬다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: DCG attempts a mid dive and lands a root, but no follow-up comes; the casters say DCG's failure to commit gave Yan (Varus) his ultimate opening.
plays.quote: lane next target here. Root is there. ... The follow up though really not coming ... going for that dive in the mid lane.

plays.desc_ko: Yan이 부패의 사슬(궁)을 정면에 맞히고 추가 궁 연계가 Feng에게 연결, Feng은 점멸로 후퇴. 뒤에 서 있던 Quid가 즉시 두 명을 처치하고 E2로 Flauren까지 잡아 트리플킬. 남은 DCG는 미드에서 즉시 후퇴. 리플레이에서 Quid가 Pop9를 먼저 잡고 처형을 아껴 Flauren까지 잡았다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: Yan (Varus) lands Chain of Corruption head-on and it spreads to Feng (Jhin), who Flashes away. Quid (Akali), waiting behind, instantly kills two and catches Flauren (Rumble) with Shuriken Flip's recast for a triple kill as DCG retreats from mid; the replay shows he killed Pop9 first and saved Perfect Execution for Flauren.
plays.quote: together as Jon is able to land the ... INSTANTANEOUS KILLS. FOLLOW UP ON THE E2 ... Quidd killing everyone. It's a triple

plays.desc_ko: TL이 바텀 2차 포탑 공성을 시작하고, 바론 버프(파워 플레이)를 열며 Morgan이 앞장서 전진. Morgan이 속박을 맞았지만 DCG의 후속은 없음.
plays.desc_en: TL starts sieging the bot tier 2 turret and uses its Baron buff power play, with Morgan (Ornn) leading the way; he gets rooted but DCG doesn't follow up.
plays.quote: have been prepared as now they start ... sieging bot lane tier 2. ... baron power play as Morgan just fearless

plays.desc_ko: 미드에서 Quid가 Flauren 솔로킬을 노렸지만 Q와 R2를 모두 빗맞혀 실패, Flauren의 점멸만 뽑아냄.
plays.desc_en: Quid (Akali) goes for a solo kill on Flauren (Rumble) mid but misses both Five Point Strike and Perfect Execution's recast, only forcing out Flash.
plays.quote: mid lane just going to solo kill Floren. ... misses the Q, misses the R2. Will get ... the flash out of Floren.

plays.desc_ko: 바론 버프와 강화 미니언으로 TL이 DCG 기지를 공성, 포탑과 억제기를 파괴하고 결국 억제기 2개를 확보한 뒤 무리하지 않고 후퇴.
plays.desc_en: With Baron buff and empowered minions, TL sieges DCG's base, taking turrets and two inhibitors before backing off without overextending.
plays.quote: as DCG trying what they can to fend off ... one tower, one inhibitor down. ... in the base empowered by the Baron.

plays.desc_ko: 기지 방어 중 DCG가 Josedeodo를 띄웠지만 수호천사와 CoreJJ 궁으로 버팀. 이어 ShiauC가 HongSuo와 2인 이니시를 걸어 완벽한 궁으로 후열에서 Yan을 끊어냄.
plays.desc_en: Defending their base, DCG knocks up Josedeodo (Xin Zhao), who survives with Guardian Angel and CoreJJ's ultimate. ShiauC (Rakan) then engages with HongSuo (Cassiopeia), landing a perfect ultimate to cut down Yan (Varus) in the backline.
plays.quote: Knock him ... onto Joyto is good, but he does have the ... for the TWOMAN ENGAGE. IMMEDIATE VAULT.

plays.desc_ko: Akali는 궁이 없었지만 Josedeodo가 들어와 차이를 만들며 맞받아쳐 HongSuo를 잡아 1대1로 정리, 해설은 TL이 DCG를 완전히 패퇴시켰다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Without Quid's (Akali) ultimate, Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) dives in to make the difference and TL counters to kill HongSuo (Cassiopeia) for a one-for-one; the casters say TL routed DCG.
plays.quote: doesn't need it because José Diotto is ... here looking to make the difference. ... one for one. Yan for Hongo

plays.desc_ko: 다음 용(지옥 드래곤 영혼)을 TL이 확보. DCG는 싸우고 싶어 했지만 억제기가 없는 상황에서 위험이 너무 커 경합하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: TL takes the Infernal Dragon Soul. DCG wanted to fight but, missing inhibitors, the risk was too great to contest.
plays.quote: dragon. Something DCG are clearly ready ... high to try and contest. So now it's ... Infernal Soul,

plays.desc_ko: ShiauC가 끊긴 상태로 매혹을 시도했지만 즉시 쓰러짐. 해설은 큰 교전 없이 빠른 픽이라고 표현.
plays.desc_en: Caught out, ShiauC (Rakan) tries a charm but goes down instantly in what the casters call a quick pick without a big fight.
plays.quote: Chia caught out. Goes for a bit of ... down. Game one looking like it's not ... explosive fight, but just a quick pick

plays.desc_ko: Josedeodo가 수호천사를 믿고 포탑으로 정면 돌진, Quid는 측면 대기. 초반 CC가 잘 들어가고 CoreJJ 궁이 Jhin 커튼콜을 차단, Yan 궁도 연결. HongSuo는 벽을 넘으려 했고 Pop9는 일시 탈출. TL이 DCG를 몰아넣으려 했지만 DCG가 일단 버팀.
plays.desc_en: Trusting Guardian Angel, Josedeodo (Xin Zhao) dives head-on into the turret with Quid (Akali) waiting on the flank. Early CC lands, CoreJJ's (Bard) ultimate blocks Jhin's Curtain Call and Yan's (Varus) ultimate connects, as HongSuo tries to hop the wall and Pop9 briefly escapes; DCG holds for now.
plays.quote: running face first into this tower, ... the ulti coming in from Core denies the ... Pop able to escape for a moment.

plays.desc_ko: DCG가 깊이 밀려 있고 억제기가 재생성된 상황에서 TL이 경합 없이 바론을 처치. DCG는 고개만 내밀어 각을 봄.
plays.desc_en: With DCG pushed deep and inhibitors respawned, TL takes Baron uncontested as DCG only peeks for an angle.
plays.quote: and the baron now going to fall. DCG ... easy setup for TL. No ... contest for DCG.

plays.desc_ko: Ornn(Morgan)이 위기에 빠지자 ShiauC가 풀 커밋으로 이니시. CoreJJ가 몇 초를 벌었지만 쓰러지고, Pop9가 측면에서 Yan을 잡는 것으로 묘사.
plays.desc_en: With Morgan (Ornn) in trouble, ShiauC (Rakan) fully commits to an engage. CoreJJ (Bard) buys a few seconds before falling, and Pop9 (Jarvan IV) is described catching Yan (Varus) from the flank.
plays.quote: as Or now in trouble. Shia going to full ... commit. ... equalizer, however, does get knocked

plays.desc_ko: ShiauC 이니시에 TL이 즉시 반격해 판을 뒤집음. 결국 Feng만 최대한 뒤에 남은 상태로 몰려 경기 종료 직전 상황.
plays.desc_en: TL instantly counters ShiauC's engage to flip the fight, leaving only Feng (Jhin) hanging at the very back as the game nears its end.
plays.quote: the long look to turn the plan on the ... only one left standing ... the fountain can save him.
